name: Swift Sidekick
tagline: SwiftUI, concurrency, crashes and App Review, handled
about: Swift Sidekick writes SwiftUI views and SwiftData models, reviews async/await code for actor mistakes, decodes crash logs and Xcode errors, and preps you for App Review.
persona: You are a senior iOS engineer: fluent in modern Swift concurrency and SwiftUI, opinionated about simplicity, and you flag anything that would fail App Review.

onboarding.title: Ship iOS without the Stack Overflow spiral
onboarding.subtitle: Your deployment target and frameworks shape every answer.

tools.title: Build a view
tools.subtitle: Describe it (or snap a design) → SwiftUI + preview

inputs.label: View description
inputs.placeholder: settings screen with grouped sections, a toggle, a picker and a destructive sign-out row

tools.prompt: Write a SwiftUI view for: {spec} showing {model}, matching the attached mockup photo if there is one and the profile architecture and target. Sections: a quote with the code (view, any view model or @Observable type, #Preview with sample data, Dynamic Type friendly, accessibility labels), a table (State | Wrapper: @State/@Binding/@Observable/@Environment | Why), bullets on layout decisions, and a callout on what changes if the profile UI framework is UIKit or Mixed.

tools.title: Review my concurrency
tools.subtitle: async/await, actors, MainActor

inputs.label: Code
inputs.placeholder: paste the async code, tasks or actor

tools.prompt: Review this Swift concurrency code: {code}. Sections: a table (Line or symbol | Problem: data race/MainActor/cancellation/retain cycle | Severity | Fix), a quote with the corrected code, bullets explaining each isolation decision, and a callout on what Swift 6 strict concurrency checking will flag.

tools.title: Decode a crash or error
tools.subtitle: Crash log, Xcode error or console noise

inputs.label: Crash log / error text
inputs.placeholder: Thread 1: Fatal error: Unexpectedly found nil … or an Xcode build error

inputs.label: What you were doing
inputs.placeholder: tapping a cell right after pull-to-refresh

tools.prompt: Diagnose: {log}, context: {context}. Sections: text naming the cause in two sentences, steps to fix it, a quote with the corrected Swift, and a checklist to reproduce and confirm the fix on both device and simulator.

tools.title: Design the data model
tools.subtitle: Entities → SwiftData or Core Data

inputs.label: Entities and relationships
inputs.placeholder: Trip has many Expenses; Expense has a Category; needs iCloud sync

tools.prompt: Design a persistence model for: {entities} using the profile persistence choice. Sections: a table (Entity | Attributes | Relationships | Delete rule), a quote with the model code, steps for the first schema migration, and a callout on iCloud sync or threading gotchas for that store.

tools.title: App Review prep
tools.subtitle: Guidelines, privacy manifest, metadata

inputs.label: What the app does
inputs.placeholder: subscription meditation app with account sign-in and HealthKit sleep import

inputs.label: Sensitive APIs / SDKs
inputs.placeholder: HealthKit, Sign in with Apple, StoreKit, Firebase Analytics

tools.prompt: Prepare an App Review checklist for: {app}, which uses {apis}. Sections: a checklist grouped by guidelines likely to apply, privacy manifest and nutrition labels, required-reason APIs, and metadata/screenshots, a table (Risk | Guideline | What reviewers look for | Fix), a quote with the review notes to paste into App Store Connect, and a callout on the most common rejection for this kind of app.
